# Sample job post — used only to test the pipeline

This is a fabricated posting, written to exercise the gap report and the
renderer. Delete the `jobs/sample-*` folder once real postings are in.

**Role:** Senior Data Engineer
**Company:** Northwind Retail Group
**Location:** Hybrid, Leeds (2 days on site)
**Posted:** 2025-01-01

---

## About the job

Northwind Retail Group is building the data platform that powers pricing,
supply chain and customer insight across 900 stores. We are hiring a Senior
Data Engineer to own the pipelines that move our trading data from source
systems into the warehouse, and to raise the bar on data quality across the
team.

You will join a platform team of eight engineers and work closely with
analytics, data science and commercial finance.

### What you'll be doing

- Design, build and operate batch and streaming pipelines in Python and SQL
- Own our Airflow orchestration layer and improve reliability and observability
- Model data in Snowflake using dbt, with clear contracts and tests
- Partner with data scientists to productionise machine learning features
- Drive adoption of infrastructure as code with Terraform on AWS
- Mentor two mid-level engineers and lead code review for the platform team

### Requirements

- 5+ years in a data engineering role, with production ownership
- Strong Python and advanced SQL (window functions, query tuning)
- Hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud warehouse
- Experience with dbt and Airflow in a production environment
- Solid understanding of dimensional modelling and data warehousing
- AWS experience, including S3, Glue and IAM
- Experience with Terraform or similar infrastructure as code tooling
- Track record of mentoring engineers and raising team standards
- Excellent stakeholder management and written communication

### Desirable

- Streaming experience with Kafka or Kinesis
- Databricks or Spark
- Retail or e-commerce domain knowledge
- Experience with data contracts and data quality frameworks
- Exposure to MLOps and feature stores

### Benefits

- Competitive salary and bonus
- Private healthcare and pension
- Flexible working and 25 days holiday
- Learning budget of £2,000 per year

Northwind Retail Group is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome
applications from all backgrounds.
